sections.overview: Reptile Database uses Hydrophis anomalus for this marine snake. WoRMS still accepts the name Thalassophis anomalus.
sections.identification: Published descriptions report a grey back, pale underside and dark bands; the species reaches about 81 cm in one account.
sections.habitat: It is marine. Records include the Gulf of Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore and parts of Indonesia.
sections.diet: The consulted accounts give little species-specific detail on diet.
sections.behavior: It is venomous; the accounts give little further detail on behavior.
sections.reproduction: The Reptile Database describes it as ovoviviparous.
sections.ecology: The Reptile Database says its generic assignment is uncertain because phylogenetic data are lacking.
sections.conservation: IUCN classified it as Data Deficient in its 2010 assessment.
